protocol.name: common final holdout
protocol.heavy_forecasts: Rescored from frozen released paths; no new fitting or pretraining-data audit is implied.
protocol.light_forecasts: Recomputed on reconstructed contiguous original history, verified against every released display sample and target; the final holdout is never supplied to fit.
protocol.history: Full-precision source observations; replay traces are display-decimated and never used as consecutive fitting inputs. Released targets and frozen predictions retain their four-decimal precision.
protocol.limits: Fifteen selected cases and one origin per case do not establish population superiority or significance.
